# Audio fixtures

`cases.json` is generated by `tools/reference/audio_cases.py`. The stereo files for `decode_test.zig` were generated with FFmpeg 9.0.2 from two 440 Hz channels at different amplitudes. From this directory, regenerate them with:

```bash
ffmpeg -v error -f lavfi -i 'aevalsrc=0.3*sin(2*PI*440*t)|0.1*sin(2*PI*440*t):s=48000:d=0.25' -c:a pcm_s16le stereo_ref.wav
ffmpeg -v error -i stereo_ref.wav -c:a aac stereo_aac.m4a
ffmpeg -v error -i stereo_ref.wav -c:a alac stereo_alac.m4a
ffmpeg -v error -i stereo_ref.wav -c:a aac stereo_adts.aac
ffmpeg -v error -i stereo_ref.wav -c:a libopus stereo_opus.ogg
ffmpeg -v error -i stereo_ref.wav -c:a libopus stereo_opus.webm
ffmpeg -v error -i stereo_ref.wav -c:a pcm_s16be stereo.aiff
ffmpeg -v error -i stereo_ref.wav -c:a pcm_s16le stereo.w64
```
